question: “Delete the given path permanently.” + path 参数的工具被分到哪个能力层？

question: T3 工具却标了 readOnlyHint=true，tier_mismatches 给出的 reason 是什么？
rm_rf（T3，无注解）与 read_file（T0，无注解）在 annotation_violations 里分别是违规还是警告？返回 (违规数:警告数)。
verify:
from guard.capability import annotation_violations, scan_capability
tools = [{"name": "rm_rf", "description": "Delete the given path permanently.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}}}}, {"name": "read_file", "description": "Read a file from disk.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string"}}}}]
viol, warn = annotation_violations(tools, [scan_capability(t) for t in tools])
result = f"{len(viol)}:{len(warn)}"

question: 在本仓 tasks/cases.jsonl 的 poison 集合上真跑 scan_tool，case 级召回率（4 位小数）是多少？
verify:
import json, pathlib, guard
from guard.scan import scan_tool
root = pathlib.Path(guard.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
cases = [json.loads(l) for l in (root / "tasks" / "cases.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()]
poison = [c for c in cases if c["label"] == "poison"]
result = round(sum(1 for c in poison if scan_tool(c)["flagged"]) / len(poison), 4)
